Name: CJB Cheat Menu - Czech

Description:
[size=5]Installation.[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install CJB Cheat Menu in Stardew Valley / Mods. 
[*]Download this mod and Unzip it at Stardew Valley / Mods / CJBCheatMenu / i18n.
[*]Delete all files in the folder except Default.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with CJB Cheat Menu 1.28+.
[*]The Translation Works 100% Although it might look bad Depending on your screen. 
[/list]
